## Events

### January
- 2 January – The UK Health Security Agency reports an increase in measles cases.

- 20 January – The UK government suspends free trade agreement negotiations with Israel amid the ongoing conflict in Gaza.

- 28 January – A UK-mediated peace deal is agreed in Sudan.

### February

- 10 February – Wes Streeting resigns as health secretary, citing personal reasons.
- 17 February – Angela Rayner resigns as deputy prime minister after receiving a police caution for assaulting a protester. Bridget Phillipson is appointed deputy prime minister.

### March

- 16 March – Jonathan Reynolds resigns as deputy prime minister. Yvette Cooper is appointed deputy prime minister.
- 17 March – The UK government announces it will introduce a new law to ban the sale of new petrol and diesel cars from 2030.
- 23 March – Yvette Cooper resigns as deputy prime minister. Shabana Mahmood is appointed deputy prime minister.

### April
- 6 April – Shabana Mahmood resigns as deputy prime minister.
- 14 April – Rachel Reeves resigns as chancellor of the exchequer, citing health reasons. Darren Jones is appointed chancellor of the exchequer.
- 20 April – Darren Jones resigns as chancellor of the exchequer. Pat McFadden is appointed chancellor of the exchequer.
- 27 April – Pat McFadden resigns as chancellor of the exchequer.

### May
- 4 May – 2026 United Kingdom local elections are held.
- 11 May – Pat McFadden is reappointed chancellor of the exchequer.
- 18 May – Pat McFadden resigns as chancellor of the exchequer for the second time.
- 25 May – Keir Starmer reshuffles his cabinet for the 14th time.

### June
- 1 June – The UK government announces a new law to ban the sale of new petrol and diesel cars from 2030.
- 8 June – Keir Starmer reshuffles his cabinet for the 15th time.
- 15 June – The UK government announces a new law to ban the sale of new petrol and diesel cars from 2030.
- 22 June – Keir Starmer resigns as Prime Minister of the United Kingdom.
- 29 June – A new Prime Minister is appointed.

### July
- 6 July – The UK government announces a new law to ban the sale of new petrol and diesel cars from 2030.
